packageRules.description: One weekly MR for all minor and patch updates
Major updates stay separate and are reviewed one by one
OpenSpec 1.14.1 promotes >500-character requirements to WARNING: unchanged main36 strict spec:check fails132/253 on 2026-10-13; retain 1.14.0, recheck future versions (wr-deploy dependency rehearsal)

pg_dump/pg_restore 18.6 and 17.11 emit transaction_timeout unsupported by the retained PostgreSQL 15 target; 16.15 passes the real backup/restore roundtrip (isolated synthetic proof 2026-10-09, TASK-359)

Existing PostgreSQL 15 data requires its storage major and Bookworm glibc collation 2.36; Trixie provides 2.41 and needs dependent indexes rebuilt before version refresh. Retain latest compatible PG15 Bookworm only for local/Helm volumes (TASK-359, 2026-10-09)

2026-10-13 actual node-saml5.1 parseDomFromString rejects xmldom0.9.12: errorHandler object is no longer supported; identical XML passes before/after on latest compatible0.8.15. Retain <0.9 until SAML consumers migrate the parser API.

2026-10-13 actual minimatch3.1.5 braceExpand({a,b}) rejects brace-expansion5.0.12: expand is not a function; unchanged case passes before/after on latest compatible1.1.21. Keep <2 only on legacy edges.
